label: Alpine Line Chart
description: Alpine line/area chart, a friendly mobile-marketing card: soft area fill, rounded line, point markers, value rail, category labels, left-to-right draw-on. Every gridline, point and tick is a real cell on one exact scale, so the chart's geometry draws the chart.

labels.label: Category Labels
labels.description: Category labels (index-aligned to values) along the x-axis.

lineColor.label: Line Color
lineColor.description: Line + marker color. Defaults to the resolved theme primary.

grid.label: Grid
grid.description: Gridlines + value ticks behind the line.

area.label: Area
area.description: Soft area fill under the line.

points.show.label: Show
points.show.description: Draw a dot at each data vertex.

points.label: Points
points.description: Point markers at each data vertex.

showTicks.label: Axis ticks
showTicks.description: Small vertical ticks on the x-axis at each labeled data point (classic chart look). Default true.

domain.minValue.label: Min Value
domain.minValue.description: Explicit domain minimum. Auto-derived when unset.

domain.maxValue.label: Max Value
domain.maxValue.description: Explicit domain maximum. Auto-derived when unset.

domain.label: Domain
domain.description: Value-axis domain overrides — leave unset to auto-fit to nice round numbers.

anim.reduceMotion.label: Reduce motion
anim.reduceMotion.description: Skip motion; render the final static card.

anim.introFrac.label: Intro length
anim.introFrac.description: Share of the clip the intro fills (the rest holds).

theme.slug.label: Producer slug
theme.slug.description: Producer template to seed tokens from (e.g. "@m0saic/theming/v1").

theme.namespace.label: Namespace
theme.namespace.description: Upstream alias to read tokens from. Default "theme".

theme.forceFetch.label: Force fetch
theme.forceFetch.description: Re-seed via the slug even if the namespace is populated.

theme.label: Theme
theme.description: Opt into a theme source. Uses the alpine preset by default; set a producer slug + namespace to pull shared design tokens. Explicit color props still win.

debugLayout.label: Debug layout
debugLayout.description: Dev-only layout contract view: renders the contract wireframe instead of the chart — x-axis ticks GREEN when each sits on its data point's x, offenders RED. Deterministic false default; production never sets it.
